sources.sourceSummaryZhTw: 固定 2026-09-01 PvPoke 快照對 #644～#649 的 15 個 Pokémon GO exact forms 都提供獨立 battle speciesId；土地雲化身／靈獸、酋雷姆三型態、凱路迪歐兩型態、美洛耶塔兩型態與蓋諾賽克特五種卡帶／無卡帶皆不得互借排名。固定 gamemaster 只對土地雲化身形態提供 Shadow battle identity。

boundary: All 15 candidate forms have independent pinned PvPoke battle identities. Landorus Incarnate/Therian, ordinary/Black/White Kyurem, Keldeo Ordinary/Resolute, Meloetta Aria/Pirouette, and all five Genesect Drive/no-drive identities keep separate ranks. Keldeo Change Form and Kyurem Fusion mechanics do not collapse their PvPoke identities. Shadow is recorded only for the concrete Landorus Incarnate Shadow speciesId; no other `_shadow` ID is synthesized. PvPoke battle presence or its internal released flag is never Pokémon GO release evidence, including Meloetta Pirouette or base Genesect.
